name: Stone Statue
description: Among the sculptures of a museum gallery, the subject hardens into weathered marble, cracks and all.

wardrobe.man: a draped off-white linen shirt and loose off-white trousers
wardrobe.woman: a draped off-white linen shirt and loose off-white trousers
wardrobe.person: a draped off-white linen shirt and loose off-white trousers

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands between classical marble statues in a long museum sculpture gallery, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}, in a calm contrapposto pose with the weight on one leg. Grey-white marble figures on pedestals line both sides, a skylight pours soft daylight from above, and the stone floor is polished. Medium-wide shot at eye level, the {subject} centered with the gallery receding behind {them}. Cinematic photography, soft top light from the skylight, gentle shadows, cool stone tones. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, plain pedestals and bare walls throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands still in contrapposto between the statues, eyes on a point just past the camera. From the feet upward, the skin and the clothes turn into grey-white veined marble, the stone climbing the legs, the torso and the arms and finally covering the face and the hair, fine cracks running across the surface and a little stone dust trickling from them, until by the last second the {subject} is a weathered marble statue in the same pose, frozen mid-breath, matching the sculptures around {them}, and one small chip breaks off the shoulder and falls. The camera pushes in slowly toward the face. Sound: grinding stone, small sharp cracks, a trickle of dust, the hush of the museum. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, marble with real veining, cracks and dust, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} in the frame slows to a stop. From the feet upward the skin and the clothes turn into grey-white veined marble, climbing the body and finally covering the face and the hair, fine cracks running across the surface and stone dust trickling from them, until by the last second the {subject} is a weathered marble statue in the same pose. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: grinding stone, small sharp cracks, a trickle of dust. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, marble with real veining, cracks and dust, sharp detail, stable picture.
